messages:
zara: Quick sync? Prober reports are too noisy for bench triage. We had 2 false FAILs yesterday because the signal payload was ambiguous.
nate: Can you paste one example?
zara: Here, top-level from last ingest: status=FAIL signals=[tokenizer_mismatch, kernel_unsupported] but no diff pct or op list. Owner had to ask for logs.
kyle: Oof. We should standardize a minimal signal shape: id, severity, reason_short, howto, details_link, artifact_id. Enough to triage without digging.
tara: Operator POV: include runtime tags too, e.g., cpu_arch, cuda_compute, libcudnn_version. Some failures are environment-related.
zara: Agreed. Also let's reduce noise by introducing a severity threshold: if severity=low then no status promotion unless owner opts in for strict mode.
nate: Proposal: prober returns signals as an ordered list with explicit fields. Example like: `signal=tokenizer_mismatch;severity=high;diff_pct=2.9;artifact=art-123` and a small human-friendly summary line at top.
kyle: I want the bench to get the signed artifact id so it can pull reproducible inputs and gold outputs. No ad-hoc copies in bench runs.
ops-bot: Note: ingest 5012 failed validation step for model alpha. Ticket: https://infra/tickets/822
tara: On canary policy: add a 3-stage admission flow - shadow -> canary -> full. Shadow always allowed when PASS. Canary only if p95 latency < baseline*1.2 and token-diff < threshold.
zara: Also include a concurrency cap in descriptor, e.g., canary_concurrency: 10 and canary_pct: 5.
nate: UX: ingest UI should show 1-line verdict, quick explainers for each signal, plus a 1-click re-run prober with `--verbose`. Saves time.
kyle: For quantized blobs: prober should run a kernel probe that returns missing_kernels=[Conv2d, MatMul], fallback_suggestion=use-ptq or build-kernels. That avoids bench wasting time.
tara: For warmup/coldstart: include warmup_sim containing 10 sample requests and a recommended_warmup_steps number. Bench can simulate that too.
zara: Observability: bench reports must embed a small golden-diff histogram and attach the single largest divergence pair. Even one counterexample cuts debug time.
ci-bot: created ENG-ml-7429 prober-contracts draft assigned to nate
nate: I'll draft the prober -> bench contract doc today: signal schema, artifact signing, perf metrics, and canary fields.
zara: Awesome. Kyle will add kernel-probe shim to the prober. Tara will update ops runbook to check env tags on failures. We reconvene next Wed to lock RFC edits. :thumbsup:
